_about: Class 1 translations for languages in PREVIEW: drafted by Claude (AI) for EC Play in November 2026 and not yet checked by native speakers. The app labels these languages 'Preview' until each is reviewed. Keys are the English strings used in content/levels/1-*.json. Apply with: node scripts/apply-preview-languages.mjs (verified by scripts/verify-preview-languages.mjs). To mark a language reviewed, set its status to 'reviewed' and record who reviewed it.
